title: The first aircraft to fly on another planet
description: Footage from NASA's Perseverance rover captures Ingenuity making historic flights across the thin atmosphere of Mars. Designed for just five test flights, the small helicopter completed 72 missions over nearly three years.

shots.narration: This is the first aircraft ever to perform powered, controlled flight on another world.
On April 19, 2021, Ingenuity completed a three-metre hover lasting about 39 seconds.
Mars air is only about one percent as dense as Earth's at sea level.
Its dual rotors span 1.2 metres and spin at around 2,400 rpm to gain lift.
Here, the 1.8-kilogram craft operates over the dusty surface recorded by Perseverance.
Tucked away inside, it carried a small piece of fabric from the Wright brothers' 1903 Flyer.
Built for five test flights in 30 days, it completed 72 flights over almost three years.
Across those flights, it covered more than 17 kilometres and reached speeds of 36 km/h.
The mission ended in January 2024 when a rotor blade was damaged on landing.
